label: Side Pleat

profile.distinguishingDetail: Side pleats, also called rear or knife pleats, are two folds positioned below the yoke near each shoulder blade rather than at the center. Each adds a small amount of fabric for ease of movement while keeping the center back clean and uninterrupted. They are a discreet, professional way to add room without the casual look of a center pleat.
